title: Austin's State of City Address: Mayor & RECA
summary:
*   **Mayor's Annual Address:** City leaders will attend Mayor Leffingwell's "State of the City Address."
*   **No Policy Decisions:** While a quorum of members may be present, no official actions, votes, or policy decisions will be made during this event.
*   **Event Sponsor:** The address is sponsored by the Real Estate Council of Austin (RECA).
transcript:
AUSTIN CITY COUNCIL 
 
COUNCIL DISCUSSION 
TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 05, 2013 
11:30 AM 
FOUR SEASONS HOTEL,  
98 SAN JACINTO BLVD, AUSTIN, TX 
 
 
“State of the City Address” Discussion 
 
Agenda 
 
 
  
 
11:30 a.m.   
Attend Mayor Leffingwell’s “State of the City Address”, 
sponsored by the Real Estate Council of Austin (RECA) 
 
  
 
 
 
 
A quorum of Council members may be present. No action will be taken.  
 
The City of Austin is committed to compliance with the American with Disabilities Act.  
Reasonable modifications and equal access to communications will be provided upon 
request.  Meeting locations are planned with wheelchair access.  If requiring Sign 
Language Interpreters or alternative formats, please give notice at least 4 days before the 
meeting date.  Please call Dolores Gonzalez, City of Austin ADA Coordinator, at (512) 
974-3256 for additional information; TTY users route through Relay Texas at 711.
